title: itembank session file
description: The resumable JSON session file written by 'itembank start' and read/written by 'next' and 'submit'. A session read whose schema_version is older than this document's current version is upgraded forward through runtime.upgrade_session before this shape is checked; a newer schema_version is rejected by name rather than guessed at. Version 2 (Phase 6) adds the versioned per-item teaching_state contract (D-03); the v1-to-v2 upgrade in runtime.SESSION_UPGRADES initializes it to an empty object. Version 3 (Phase 9) adds the nullable subject_profile snapshot: the resolved subject id, registry/profile versions, the full resolved profile (lesson capabilities, allowed item types, verifier) and any requested unavailable capabilities. New sessions persist the complete snapshot; legacy v2 sessions upgrade with a null slot that the session adapter fills once from the bank on the first action (D-04).

bank.description: Absolute path to the bank this session was started against

items.description: Indices into the parsed bank, not copies of the items themselves -- re-parsing the bank always agrees with this list

cursor.description: Position of the next unanswered item in items

selection_mode.description: The selection composition that chose this session's items; `mode` is the feedback policy that governs what the learner is shown. Optional: a session written before plan 07-04 has none.

objective.description: Empty string when the session was not limited to one objective

served_ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the current item was served, used to compute response_time_ms. Optional: a session written before plan 01-02 has none.

teaching_state.description: Versioned per-item teaching state (D-03, Phase 6): keyed by the stable item identity (opaque [ID:] when assigned, else 'ref:<positional id>'). Each record tracks attempt count, highest tier unlocked/shown, the last genuine canonical response, its response event id, and the ordered shown-tier snapshots. The v1-to-v2 upgrade initializes this to an empty object; a v1 session read through runtime.upgrade_session always carries it.

subject_profile.description: The persisted subject/profile snapshot (Phase 9, D-04). A new session carries the complete non-null snapshot; a legacy v2 session upgraded to v3 carries null until the session adapter fills it once from the bank on the first action.

registry_version.description: The version of the subject-profile registry that selected this profile

profile_version.description: The version of the selected profile itself

subject_id.description: The selected subject namespace, or '' for the conservative default

unsupported_capabilities.description: Requested capabilities the selected profile does not support, by name

lesson_layout.description: Phase 3.1 D-04 fold: separate is the classic two-file lesson page; inline embeds lesson prose in the working surface.

verifier.description: The named verifier that scores this subject's items (e.g. 'runtime')

attempt_count.description: Number of materially distinct, non-empty canonical responses (D-04); duplicate and empty replays never increment it.

highest_tier_unlocked.description: Highest fixed tier made available by genuine attempts/stumped actions; -1 means nothing unlocked yet.

highest_tier_shown.description: Highest fixed tier actually shown via hint/stumped reveal; -1 means nothing shown yet.

last_genuine_canonical.description: The idempotency-canonical form of the most recent genuine response, or null when none exists; used to distinguish a materially different retry from a duplicate replay.

last_response_event_id.description: The event_id of the most recent genuine response event, when one has been recorded.

shown_tiers.description: Ordered snapshots of every tier shown, in the order shown.

item_id.description: The Qn-derived positional id (see item.schema.json's own id field), not the opaque [ID:] identity field

answer.description: The learner's raw response, shaped per item type -- a string, an array, or an object

score.description: true, false, or null for a constructed response not yet marked

status.description: The evidence writer's status for this response (plan 01-07). Always 'recorded' here: an 'already_recorded' retry is never appended to this array in the first place, so no second entry double-counts it in a later report. Optional: a session written before plan 01-07 has none.
